title: Broncos list Riley Moss as questionable; rule out Pat Surtain II and Talanoa Hufanga

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Broncos list Riley Moss as questionable; rule out Pat Surtain II and Talanoa Hufanga
sources.description: The Broncos may have cornerback Riley Moss in the lineup against the Seahawks on Thursday night, but they'll be short a couple of defensive backs even if he does play.
